fields.description: Server: the group site that receives data from company sites. Client: a company site that sends its data to the server.
fields.label: Mode

fields.description: The address other sites use to reach this site, like https://erp.example.com. Left empty, it is taken from the site's host_name. The other site must have it saved exactly the same way.
fields.label: This Site's URL

fields.description: Lets http:// addresses through for local testing. It has no effect unless the bench is in developer mode. Never turn it on in production.
fields.label: Allow Plain HTTP (Testing Only)

fields.description: Created when the mode is first saved. The other site's admin compares this before approving or connecting.
fields.label: This Site's Key Fingerprint

fields.description: The key this client is switching to while a key rotation is in progress.
fields.label: Pending Public Key

fields.description: The group server's address, like https://group.example.com
fields.label: Server URL
Connection Status
fields.options:
Not connected
Waiting for approval
Connected
Not authorised
Error

fields.description: Saved the first time this site connects. If the server ever shows a different key, connecting stops.
fields.label: Server Key Fingerprint

fields.description: On the schedule the server sets, documents with other group companies (invoices, payments and journal entries, header only) and the balances with them are sent to the server. Group companies are matched by PAN or GSTIN.
fields.label: Data Sync

fields.description: Watermarks and the watch list. Managed by sync.
fields.label: Sync State

fields.description: Every client site follows these rules. A change reaches each client on its next sync.
fields.label: Data Sync Rules

fields.description: Documents posted before this date are not sent. Leave empty to send the full history. Moving it earlier makes every client send its documents again; moving it later keeps what is already stored.
fields.label: Sync Documents From

fields.description: How often each client sends what changed.
fields.label: Sync Every
fields.options:
5 minutes
15 minutes
30 minutes
1 hour
6 hours
1 day

fields.description: Only sites on this list can connect. Add a site's exact URL, ask its admin to click Connect, compare fingerprints, then select the row and approve it.
fields.label: Allowed Client Sites
